title: ASE v3 Front-end Scaling: Signals, Timing, and Cost
summary: Understand observed front-end scaling delays, distinguish configured capacity from actual instances, and plan capacity ahead of demand.
sourceDocuments: ASE v3 metric-driven minimum front-end instance adjustment and subsequent scheduled-capacity design
omissions: Two original portal screenshots were omitted because they can expose subscription and environment details; their technical findings are described in text.
Original subscription, tenant, principal, support-case, resource, host, IP, owner, and local-path identifiers are not published.
The source refers to local runbooks, polling scripts, a cost-query script, and a sample application that are not present in the repository. They are not offered as downloads.
Historical permission-bypass advice and broad network/basic-authentication changes are not reproduced as deployment recommendations.
